cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

# Generated by configure.py at /media/kudoyk/01s48/hairdesc_gpu/gpu-tutorial/apps/fem/configure.py
# Source yamls: app.yaml, implementations.yaml, machines/local.yaml
# Config: variant=C++/openacc/auto.def machine=local mode=gpu compiler=nvhpc
# DO NOT EDIT — re-run configure.py to regenerate.

# Compilers (must be set before project())
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER "nvc")
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER "nvc++")
set(CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER "nvfortran")

project(fem LANGUAGES C)

# Cache variables (override via -DFP=64 etc.)
set(FP "32" CACHE STRING "Floating point bits (32 or 64)")
set(NTHREADS "128" CACHE STRING "Threads (for omp-target/openacc opt variant)")

# Per-language compile flags
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "-tp=native -O3 -I. -Wall -Minfo=accel,opt,mp -mp -acc=gpu -gpu=mem:managed")

# Defines (compile-time macros)
add_compile_definitions(FP=${FP} BENCHMARK_MODE)

# Include dirs
include_directories(".")

# Link flags (parallel + memory model, etc.)
add_link_options(-mp -acc=gpu -gpu=mem:managed)

# Target
add_executable(fem src/allocate.c src/define_file_name.c src/input_cntl.c src/input_grid.c src/mat_con0.c src/mat_con1.c src/mat_ass_bc.c src/mat_ass_main.c src/solver_CG.c src/solve11.c src/output_ucd.c src/util.c src/test1.c)
set_target_properties(fem PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "fem.gpu.${FP}")
target_link_libraries(fem PRIVATE -lm)
